overview_description.description:
PlayTreks is an all-in-one digital workspace built for music professionals, including artists, record labels, managers, and producers. Headquartered in Hasselt, the company was founded by experienced producers and label owners who set out to solve long-standing music industry challenges such as limited transparency, inefficient workflows, and the heavy reliance on intermediaries that reduce artists’ earnings.

At the core of the platform is an AI-powered music distribution and analytics ecosystem that enables creators to distribute music to more than 220 streaming services and social platforms, including Spotify, Apple Music, and TikTok, while retaining 100% of their royalties. PlayTreks also provides an advanced analytics dashboard that aggregates performance data from streaming platforms, social media, radio airplay across more than 30,000 stations, and music charts, giving artists valuable insights into audience behavior, demographics, and engagement.

A defining feature of PlayTreks is its integration of blockchain and Web3 technologies through its NFT marketplace, “The Playgrounds.” This marketplace enables artists to mint music, artwork, VIP tickets, and other digital assets as NFTs, opening new monetization opportunities and fostering deeper fan engagement. The platform also leverages NFTs to simplify music licensing by allowing artists to define their own licensing terms and sell directly to buyers without traditional intermediaries.

By combining AI-driven analytics, global music distribution, and blockchain-powered ownership tools, PlayTreks positions itself as a bridge between the traditional music industry and the rapidly evolving Web3 ecosystem.

about_short_description.short_description: PlayTreks is an all-in-one digital workspace built for music professionals, including artists, record labels, managers, and producers.

product.name: Music Distribution
product.description: A platform service that enables users to upload, manage, and distribute music releases to over 200 digital streaming and social media platforms worldwide.

product.name: Performance Analytics (Data Dashboard)
product.description: An analytics platform that aggregates and visualizes music performance data from streaming, social media, charts, playlists, and radio airplay to provide actionable insights.

product.name: Automated Royalty Management
product.description: A system for creating contracts, managing custom royalty splits, tracking recoupments, and automating royalty payments to collaborators.

product.name: Copyright Control
product.description: A blockchain-based service that registers and secures music copyrights, providing instant proof of ownership for compositions, lyrics, and recordings.

product.name: NFT Marketplace (The Playgrounds)
product.description: A marketplace platform for creating, selling, and managing music-related NFTs and digital collectibles to engage fans and generate new revenue streams.

product.name: Radio Airplay Monitoring
product.description: A service that tracks and reports real-time radio airplay data from over 30,000 radio stations worldwide to inform promotion and marketing strategies.
